auth.title: Coordinator sign-in
auth.subtitle: Sign in with the email address and password an administrator gave you.
auth.accessNotice: Coordinator accounts are created by an administrator. There is no sign-up here, and no way to recover a password from this page — ask an administrator for a new temporary one.

status.wrongRole: That account cannot use this portal.

awaitingContract.description: This area needs {endpoint}, which v-backend has not published yet. Nothing is shown rather than something invented.

expired.description: Sign in again to carry on where you left off.

denied.title: You cannot open this

unconfigured.description: VOLONTYORLAR_API_URL is not set, so nothing can be read. This is a deployment setting, not something you can fix here.

failed.title: This did not load
failed.description: Something went wrong on the way to the API. Reload the page to try again.

passwordChangeRequired.title: Change your password first
passwordChangeRequired.description: An administrator set a temporary password on your account. Change it and this screen will work again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Everything below counts only the vacancies you created.

next.title: What needs you next
next.review: Review {count, plural, =0 {no applications} one {one application} other {# applications}}
next.attendance: Confirm {count, plural, =0 {no attendance} one {one attendance record} other {# attendance records}}

vacancies.title: Vacancies
vacancies.description: The vacancies you created, from draft to archive.

empty.title: No vacancies yet
empty.description: Create a vacancy, publish it once its organization is verified, and applications arrive here.

noMatches.title: Nothing matches those filters
noMatches.description: Clear the filters to see every vacancy again.

detail.questionsLegacy: Kept from an older vacancy. A new vacancy asks nothing beyond the reusable profile.

fields.title: Title
fields.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens. It becomes part of the public link.
fields.organizationHelp: Only a verified organization can have its vacancies published.
fields.capacityHelp: Optional. Leave blank when there is no fixed limit.
fields.estimatedTotalHoursHelp: Optional. Hours a volunteer is expected to earn for the whole event.
fields.acceptanceModeHelp: Either way, you can still reject an accepted volunteer from their application.

acceptanceModes.manual: You review each application and accept or reject it.
acceptanceModes.automatic: Everyone who applies is accepted at once. A place limit applies only if you set one.

fields.locationNameHelp: Optional. The venue or a public description of where the work happens online. Never a meeting password.
fields.cityHelp: Optional. Add the city for in-person work.

form.createDescription: A new vacancy starts as a draft. Open it after creation to add a photo before sending it for approval.
form.noOrganizations: No organization is available yet, so a vacancy cannot be created. Ask an administrator to add one.
form.unverifiedNotice: This organization is not verified yet. A vacancy under it cannot be approved until an administrator verifies it.
form.editDescription: Saving changes to a published vacancy hides it until you send it for approval again.

image.title: Vacancy photo
image.description: The photo appears on the volunteer vacancy card and detail page. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
image.reviewNotice: Changing a published vacancy hides it from volunteers until an administrator approves it again.

archive.title: Archive this vacancy?
archive.description: It stops accepting applications and disappears from the public list. This cannot be undone from here.

vacancies.archivedNotice: This vacancy is archived. It can no longer be edited.

submit.title: Send this vacancy for approval?
submit.description: An administrator decides whether it is published. You cannot edit it while they are looking at it.
submit.success: The vacancy was sent for approval.

approval.title: Approval
approval.description: An administrator decides whether this vacancy reaches volunteers.
approval.pendingDescription: The vacancy is locked while it is reviewed. You can archive it, but not edit it.
approval.changesDescription: Edit the vacancy and send it for approval again.
approval.rejectedDescription: It stays read-only. Create a new vacancy instead.
approval.missingDescription: Fill these in before sending it:
approval.readyBlocked: This vacancy is not ready yet
approval.readyLine: Everything approval needs is in place.

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: Applications to the vacancies you created.

empty.title: No applications yet
empty.description: Applications appear here once volunteers apply to your published vacancies.

noMatches.title: Nothing matches those filters
noMatches.description: Clear the filters to see every application again.

detail.snapshotNote: This is the profile the volunteer submitted with the application, not their profile today.

review.title: Record a decision
review.noteHelp: Optional. The volunteer can read this.

draft.title: Not sent yet
draft.description: The volunteer started this application but hasn't sent it, so there is nothing to decide yet.

withdrawn.title: Withdrawn by the volunteer
withdrawn.description: The volunteer took this application back, so no decision is needed.

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: This decision is final. The volunteer sees it as “Not selected”.

closed.title: Closed
closed.description: This decision is final. The volunteer sees it as “Closed”.

users.title: Volunteers
users.description: Volunteers who applied to the vacancies you created.

empty.title: No volunteers yet
empty.description: A volunteer appears here after applying to one of your vacancies.

noMatches.title: No volunteer matches that search
noMatches.description: Clear the search to see everyone again.

detail.noApplications: This volunteer has no application to your vacancies.

password.title: Assign a temporary password
password.description: This replaces the volunteer's password and forces them to choose a new one at the next sign-in. Existing sessions end immediately.
password.privacy: An existing password can never be read, by anyone, here or in the API. Assigning a replacement is the only option.
password.label: Temporary password
password.help: At least 8 characters. Tell it to the volunteer over a channel you trust.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Confirm attendance and hours for volunteers you accepted.

empty.title: Nothing to confirm
empty.description: Accepted applications appear here when their attendance is still open.

table.caption: Accepted volunteers awaiting an attendance decision

resolve.title: Confirm attendance
resolve.description: This decision counts towards the volunteer's record, so it cannot be undone from here.

queue.total: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is waiting} one {# volunteer is waiting} other {# volunteers are waiting}}
queue.waiting: {count, plural, one {# volunteer to confirm} other {# volunteers to confirm}}
queue.opensAt: Opens {when}, once the event has ended.
queue.opensUnknown: Opens once the event has ended.
queue.resolvedCount: {count, plural, one {# volunteer already confirmed} other {# volunteers already confirmed}}

roster.title: Attendance
roster.description: Confirm who turned up once the event has ended.
roster.caption: Accepted volunteers and their attendance
roster.closedDescription: It opens when the event ends, on {when}.
roster.closedUnknown: It opens when the event ends.
roster.selected: {count, plural, =0 {No one selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
roster.batchHelp: One outcome and one number of hours for everyone selected. Correct a single row afterwards.
roster.hoursHelp: Starts at the vacancy's estimated hours. Change it if the event ran shorter or longer.

activity.title: My activity
activity.description: Everything you did in this portal, newest first.

empty.title: No activity yet
empty.description: Publishing a vacancy, reviewing an application or confirming attendance is recorded here.

noMatches.title: Nothing matches those filters
noMatches.description: Clear the filters to see the whole history again.

account.title: Change password
account.description: Choose a new password for your coordinator account.

required.title: Choose a new password
required.description: An administrator gave you a temporary password. Change it before you can use the portal.

account.newPasswordHelp: At least 8 characters. Do not reuse a password from anywhere else.
